highlights: The AI agent landscape is rapidly advancing with specialized coding agents, enhanced voice models, and advanced tool retrieval capabilities enabling more sophisticated automated workflows.
New open-weight models are pushing the boundaries of local inference and specialized tasks, including compact MoE models running on consumer hardware and innovative decision-making models.

Key infrastructure for AI deployment is maturing, with new orchestration APIs simplifying multi-model management and strategic partnerships aimed at making open-weight models more accessible for developers.

agents.title: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost
agents.summary: OpenAI released GPT-Live-1.1, a full-duplex voice model improving multilingual accents and transcription for voice agents, significantly reducing idle API costs to $0.02 per minute.

agents.title: RadixArk Ships DaisyRose-27B: RL-Only Agentic Coding Model
agents.summary: RadixArk introduced DaisyRose-27B, an Apache 2.0 agentic coding model trained solely with reinforcement learning, achieving over double the Terminal Bench 4.1 pass@1 score and running on a single GPU.

agents.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 4 Neon: 1M Context, #1 Coding Agent
agents.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a powerful 1M-context model priced competitively, which scores 61 on the AA Intelligence Index and ranks #1 on AA’s Coding Agent Index.

models.title: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
models.summary: Thinking Machines launched Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer with 3.4B active parameters, optimized to run on a 32GB Mac and achieving 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

models.title: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
models.summary: Baseten unveiled bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models based on Gemma 4, supporting 128k context and image input, with bison-1 scoring 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1.

models.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Nemotron-Labs-Sigma: Continuous Diffusion Language Model
models.summary: NVIDIA AI introduced Nemotron-Labs-Sigma, a series of 14 open 3B and 8B continuous diffusion language model checkpoints that denoise text in an embedding space and offer up to 4.20x faster decoding than autoregressive methods.

tools.title: Perplexity Launches Orchestrator API for Failover and Model Routing
tools.summary: Perplexity introduced its Orchestrator API, providing a single endpoint for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and open-weight models, featuring same-model provider failover, unified billing, and an auto-router.

tools.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
tools.summary: Google's Gemini API now features Tool Retrieval in preview, allowing agents to access hundreds of tools with significantly fewer tokens, enhancing agentic capabilities and efficiency.

tools.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
tools.summary: llama.cpp reached version 1.0.0, establishing a more robust and stable foundation for the local AI ecosystem, crucial for developers building and running large language models on personal hardware.

companies.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare
companies.summary: Google Cloud introduced Gemini for healthcare, designed to unify clinical data and automate workflows, aiming to reduce administrative burnout and enhance efficiency in the medical sector.

companies.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
companies.summary: Google announced the global integration of Gemini 4 Hydrogen into Google Search, promising more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses for users worldwide.

companies.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
companies.summary: Hugging Face and OpenRouter announced a partnership focused on simplifying the deployment and accessibility of open-weight models, fostering broader adoption within the AI community.

learning.title: Not If, But How: Responding to Security Incidents in the Age of AI Attackers
learning.summary: A comprehensive guide providing a 4-pillar incident response playbook to address the increasing frequency of AI-powered attacks on AI infrastructure, featuring practical examples from industry leaders.

learning.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
learning.summary: Hugging Face published a definitive guide for fine-tuning 3D generation models, offering essential knowledge and techniques for developers working with advanced generative AI applications.

learning.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
learning.summary: Google's latest AI Quest, "Polar Peaks," offers an engaging lesson on neuroscience, aimed at improving AI literacy by exploring how AI can be used to map the human brain.
